snippet.title: Bleaklight Falls Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820610/Bleaklight_Falls/

Bleaklight Falls is a 2D top-down Action RPG Tower Defense game. Join Meelu in his fight to save his home from the encroaching monsters of the Dreadblight. Bolster the tower defenses against the nightly monster attacks, form bonds with your fellow villagers, explore the secrets of the forest, collect powerful loot, and discover the mysteries of the Bleaklight!
